rationale: Correct Zenith Energy Portland Terminal's ownership state because the announced I Squared acquisition had not legally closed by August 19, 2026. The buyer signed for 100% on December 16, 2025, but Portland's required franchise-transfer ordinance was only referred to full Council on August 6, 2026 and remained unscheduled. Warburg Pincus and Kelso therefore remain active sponsors pending exit, while I Squared is recorded only as a signed pending incoming buyer through the ISQ Springer vehicle and ETIF mandate.

companyFieldUpdates.name: Zenith Energy Portland Terminal
companyFieldUpdates.description: Zenith Energy Portland Terminal is a standalone liquid-bulk storage and multimodal fuels terminal at 5501 NW Front Avenue on Portland's Willamette River. The facility connects marine, rail, truck and pipeline logistics and has 1,518,200 barrels of operator-listed storage capacity. It handles renewable fuels, sustainable-aviation-fuel components and blends, biodiesel, aviation gasoline, distillates and crude oil during a permitted transition that requires crude handling and storage to end by October 2027. Warburg Pincus and Kelso & Company acquired the broader Zenith Energy U.S. platform in 2017 and remain the current sponsors while their signed sale of the Portland terminal is pending. I Squared Capital's Energy Transition Fund, through ISQ Springer Aggregator and ISQ Springer Holdings, signed to acquire 100% on December 16, 2025. The required Portland franchise-transfer ordinance remained pending and no legal closing evidence was found through August 19, 2026, so I Squared is not represented as an active owner or assigned an investment year. The Portland terminal is counted as a standalone PortCo; its tanks, docks, pipeline, racks and conversion projects remain subordinate assets.
